card.name: Capital I starting a drug name
card.fires_on: The capital letter I when it begins a drug or brand name (Ipratropium, Itraconazole, ISENTRESS, ICLUSIG) or the abbreviation I.V. It fires on the first letter, before the rest of the name.

modes.label: Drug name starting with I
modes.description: A capital I that opens a generic or brand drug name, split from the rest of the name.

modes.label: I.V. abbreviation
modes.description: The I that begins I.V. (intravenous) after a dose amount or in parentheses.

card.writes: It pushes toward the continuation of a name that starts with I, such as ro, rod, elix, asc or oid pieces.
card.plain: It marks the first letter I of a drug name or of I.V., when more letters are still to come.
